# Preview browser libraries

These are unchanged, pinned browser builds of libraries already used by the app.
The file preview serves them locally so access to an external CDN is not required.
Keep the versioned filenames, integrity hashes, and license notices together when
updating a build. Mermaid's bundled dependency notices are included in its script.

| Local file | Upstream build | License notice |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `marked-15.0.12.min.js` | https://unpkg.com/marked@15.0.12/marked.min.js | `marked-LICENSE.md` |
| `dompurify-3.2.6.min.js` | https://unpkg.com/dompurify@3.2.6/dist/purify.min.js | `dompurify-LICENSE` |
| `mermaid-11.12.0.min.js` | https://unpkg.com/mermaid@11.12.0/dist/mermaid.min.js | `mermaid-LICENSE` |
| `highlight-11.11.1.min.js` | https://unpkg.com/@highlightjs/cdn-assets@11.11.1/highlight.min.js | `highlight-LICENSE` |
